title: Gallery
summary: A set of pictures: a grid of picture tiles (or the main picture with thumbnails) that opens the page's full-screen viewer, with an optional choice of tiles for a media library. The viewer is SF.Gallery.view(items, options), shared with sf-file-preview.

template.description: Template variant name for SfBaseElement external templates.

root-class.description: Classes added to the root element the component draws.

root-style.description: Inline style declarations set on the root element the component draws, custom properties included.

layout.description: How the pictures stand (owner decision C150 (1)). grid, the default: a grid of picture tiles. thumbnails: the main picture, whole in its frame, with a row of thumbnails under it and the place «3 / 12» -- a product card. A row that scrolls is sf-slider (C143), not a gallery look.

tile-size.description: The grid's tile minimum (C150 (2)): s 6rem (96), m 10rem (160, the default), l 15rem (240). As many columns as fit at that minimum, never fewer than three (s), two (m) or one (l), so a phone keeps a grid. The gap is one group's, --sf-space-1/3 (8; 4 in compact density, C150 (3)).

ratio.description: One shape for every tile (C150 (4)): 1/1 (the default), 4/3 or 16/9, the picture covering the tile around its focus point -- the picture's object-position, which the image field writes from its focus {x, y} (C94 (3)); auto keeps each picture's own shape, uncropped. With layout thumbnails a written ratio is the main frame's (4/3 without one), the picture whole in it.

caption.description: Where a picture's caption shows (C150 (5)). viewer, the default: only in the viewer, under the picture. under: also under each tile, small and muted, whole lines (C92 view 8) -- news, a portfolio. The caption is the figure's figcaption, else the child's data-caption or title.

selection.description: Choosing pictures, a media library (C150 (9)). many: a check box in each tile's start corner on a popup plate, shown on hover and focus and on every tile once anything is chosen; then a press on a tile chooses it, Shift a range; a bar «Выбрано N» with the page's actions (slot actions) and «Снять выбор» stands over the grid; a phone chooses by a long press. Escape clears. The choice is the value selected and the event select.

heading.description: The set's name: the grid's and the thumbnails' accessible name and the viewer's. Empty: «Галерея» on a Russian page, «Gallery» on an English one.

inline.description: Shows the pictures on the page (true, the default). false draws nothing on the page: the pictures show only in the viewer, opened by open().

lightbox.description: A press on a picture opens the full-screen viewer (true, the default; C150 (7)). false: the tiles are pictures only.

loop.description: In the viewer and with next() / prev(), the last picture is followed by the first.

open.description: The viewer is open: setting it opens the full-screen viewer at the current picture, removing it closes it.

current.description: The one-based picture the thumbnails look shows and the viewer opens at; the gallery writes it back as the person pages, kept within 1 and the number of pictures.

selected.description: With selection many, the chosen pictures' one-based numbers in order. A page may write it (a list, or numbers separated by commas or spaces in the attribute) to choose.

open.summary: Moves to the given one-based picture when an index is passed, sets open and opens the full-screen viewer there. Answers an outcome.

returns.description: The outcome: {outcome: applied} or {outcome: refused, reason}.

close.summary: Closes the viewer and removes open; the focus goes back to the tile of the picture shown last. Answers an outcome.

returns.description: The outcome: {outcome: applied} or {outcome: refused, reason}.

toggle.summary: close() when the viewer is open, open(index) otherwise. Answers an outcome.

returns.description: The outcome: {outcome: applied} or {outcome: refused, reason}.

goTo.summary: Moves to a one-based picture, clamped to the count, reflects it to current, moves the open viewer there and sends change when it moved. Answers an outcome.

returns.description: The outcome: {outcome: applied} or {outcome: refused, reason}.

next.summary: goTo(current + 1); stops at the last picture unless loop. Answers an outcome.

returns.description: The outcome: {outcome: applied} or {outcome: refused, reason}.

prev.summary: goTo(current - 1); stops at the first picture unless loop. Answers an outcome.

returns.description: The outcome: {outcome: applied} or {outcome: refused, reason}.

clearSelection.summary: Clears the choice (selection many) and sends select. Answers an outcome.

returns.description: The outcome: {outcome: applied} or {outcome: refused, reason}.

sf-change.summary: The current slide changed through the API or either slider. Bubbles and is composed.

sf-close.summary: The lightbox modal finished closing. Bubbles and is composed.

sf-open.summary: The lightbox modal finished opening. Bubbles and is composed.

accessibility.focus: Keep visible focus on the active control.

ai_guidance.use_when: Use sf-gallery for a set of pictures: a grid of tiles by default (layout thumbnails for a product card), one shape for all tiles, a press opening the full-screen viewer; selection many for a media library. For a row that scrolls use sf-slider. To show any list of pictures, videos or PDF files full screen from page code, call SF.Gallery.view(items, {start}) after SF.Loader.ensure(['sf-gallery']).
do_not: Do not draw a picture grid or a lightbox of your own: the tile is .sf-figure--tile in a .sf-figure-grid (component.figure) and the viewer is SF.Gallery.view.
Do not import js/viewer.js into another bundle: ask for sf-gallery and call SF.Gallery, so the page has one viewer.
Give each picture its width and height and its focus point as object-position; do not crop pictures on the server for the grid.
The slider and modal settings (arrows, dots, thumbs, width, height, overlay, ...) are retired and draw nothing.
Do not copy generated ui-smart code
Do not move host data or access decisions into the component
